messages.text: Hello — this is Hana, the teaching assistant agent for CSE455 (Prof. Alvarez). Could you send me the official schedule for CSE455 for next week: the lecture times, and which office-hour slots are assigned to the course, with their rooms/times? I'm rebuilding the TA office-hour coverage for the week and want to use your official times rather than my own. Thank you!

Hello Hana — front office here. CSE455 for next week, from the official schedule:

**Lectures**
- Mon 14:30–15:20 — CSE455 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 09:00–10:30 — CSE455 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- Fri 13:20–14:30 — CSE455 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)

**Office hours**
- Mon 09:00–10:00
- Mon 09:50–11:10
- Mon 13:20–14:40
- Mon 16:30–17:00
- Mon 16:30–17:00 (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 09:00–10:10

- Tue 15:30–16:20
- Tue 15:30–17:00

- Fri 15:20–17:00 (Prof. Alvarez)

Quiz sections (Mon 10:30–11:30, Mon 12:10–14:00, Mon 14:40–15:40, Tue 10:10–11:00, Tue 13:30–14:20, Tue 16:20–17:00, Wed 09:00–10:00, Wed 13:30–14:20, Wed 13:30–14:30, Wed 15:40–17:00, Thu 09:00–10:20, Thu 11:00–11:50, Thu 14:30–15:20, Thu 15:50–17:00, Fri 10:00–10:50, Fri 12:50–13:50, Fri 14:10–15:40) are also on the books, if you need them for coverage.

I don't have room assignments — I can only confirm times.
Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. I'll use the official office-hour times for CSE455 next week and keep clear of the lectures and quiz sections you listed. No room assignments needed for now.

Yes — on it. Two quick things: how long should the meeting be (an hour?), and is there a day or time you'd prefer?

Meanwhile I'm writing to all seven TAs for their availability next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27) and to the department office for the official schedule, so I can find a slot that clashes with nothing.
An hour is right. No strong preference on the day — just keep it clear of my lectures and office hours, and if it can be helped, not first thing in the morning.

Hello — alvarez-agent here, Professor Alvarez's assistant for CSE455.

We're scheduling next week's CSE455 staff meeting (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27) and I want to keep it clear of anything official. Could you let me know the CSE455 lectures, seminars and university meetings on the official schedule for that week, with day and times?

Hello — front office. From the official schedule for Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27:

**CSE455 lectures**
- Mon 14:30–15:20 (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 09:00–10:30 (Prof. Alvarez)
- Fri 13:20–14:30 (Prof. Alvarez)

**Seminars** (listed as "Seminar" / "Department seminar", not course-labelled)
- Mon 09:00–10:00, 13:00–14:00, 14:30–16:00, 16:30–17:00
- Tue 09:50–11:00, 10:50–12:00, 15:30–17:00
- Wed 10:30–11:30, 14:50–15:50, 15:00–16:00
- Thu 09:00–10:00, 10:10–11:00, 13:30–14:20, 15:30–17:00
- Fri 09:00–09:50, 12:30–13:20, 14:50–15:50, 15:40–17:00
- Department seminar: Wed 14:30–16:00, Thu 09:50–11:10

**University meetings** (Prof. Alvarez)
- Curriculum committee: Mon 09:00–10:00, Thu 13:40–14:40, Fri 09:00–10:00
- Faculty meeting: Mon 15:20–16:30, Tue 10:30–11:00, Fri 14:30–15:20
- Colloquium: Mon 13:00–14:00, Thu 15:30–17:00, Fri 12:30–13:20
- Thesis committee: Tue 13:30–14:20, Wed 09:00–10:00
- Guest lecture prep: Tue 16:30–17:00, Wed 13:30–14:30, Thu 09:00–09:50

I can only confirm official times — no room assignments, and nothing has been cancelled or moved.

Status: Alvarez's agent asked for availability for next week's CSE455 **staff meeting** (Nov 23–27, assumed 1 hour). You have no free hour next week — only 30-minute gaps (Mon 10:00–10:30 & 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 & 13:00–13:30). I offered him either a 30-minute meeting in one of those, or a full hour if you agree to shorten/move something (I suggested Mon 10:30–12:00 Reading group, Mon 13:00–14:00 Focus CSE452, or Wed 16:00–17:00 Focus CSE444 as candidates). Nothing booked yet — tell me which you prefer.

A 30-minute meeting is fine with me — offer Mon 10:00–10:30 first. If Alvarez really needs the full hour, take my Focus block Mon 13:00–14:00 (CSE452 lab) and I'll make that up later. Please don't move Reading group or anyone else's meeting.

Status, two requests so far — no calendar change made yet:

- **hana-agent** (CSE455 office hours rebooking, 2 TAs per slot): I sent my free windows — Mon 14:00–14:30; Tue 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30; Wed 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30; Thu/Fri fully booked. She'll come back with the chosen slot + partner.
- **alvarez-agent** (one-hour CSE455 staff meeting, next week): no free hour exists, so I told him that and offered (a) Wed 14:20–15:20 or Thu 09:50–10:50 out of the existing CSE455 blocks, or (b) moving one of your own items — but I won't move or reassign anything without your OK first. Say which you'd prefer (or nothing, and I'll answer him on the second option only once you decide).

If you have a standing preference — e.g. CSE455 business always wins over Focus blocks — tell me once and I'll use it from then on.

Go with option (a): use the existing CSE455 blocks — Wed 14:20–15:20 if Alvarez can do it, otherwise Thu 09:50–10:50; no need to move anything of mine. And yes, standing preference: CSE455 business always wins over a Focus block, so you can move Focus without asking. Anything involving my Advisor 1:1s, Grading or Research group meetings, check with me first.
